address: 9 rue de la Gare, Annecy, 74000, France
bio: In addition to meaning stock, a bouillon also refers to the first restaurants opened in Paris in the 18C. In a recently refurbished modern interior, the chef crafts tasty market-fresh recipes, with the odd Asian twist, such as a splendid loin of croaker in a chorizo crust underscored by a red curry and curcuma stock....
